newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-South Australia Meat Corp sold by state govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-South Australia Meat Corp sold by state govt.

text.p: The South Australian Meat Corporation (SAMCOR) will be sold for A$4.8 million to Agpro Australia Pty Ltd, a firm backed by interests in the Russian Republic of Tatarstan, the state government said on Friday.
Treasurer Stephen Baker said in a statement that settlement with Agpro, a South Australian registered company, was expected to take place later this month.

Baker said the SAMCOR meatworks currently killed livestock under contract for other companies, but under the new deal, meat would be exported to Tatarstan and other States in the Russian Federation as well as Asia and the Middle East.

The restructuring of SAMCOR would result in some job redundancies, but if the meatworks had not been offered for sale the government would have been forced to close because of its heavy drain on taxpayers, he said.
Baker said SAMCOR lost A$4.6 million in 1995/96 and had received A$3.65 million so far this financial year to keep it operational.
The state government last year called for revised bids on a lease-purchase basis for SAMCOR, saying such a proposal had been put forward by Canadian meat processor Better Beef Ltd.
